//Development: Development defaults only. Catalogue:TrustedOrigins lets the local Vite dev server (https://localhost:8282) write through its /api proxy; deployed hosts run as Production and trust only their own origin. This machine's settings live in the gitignored appsettings.Local.json, which only the https launch profile (LOCAL_SETTINGS=true) reads: Catalogue:SourceRoot (the read-only mft products folder the empty-store seed and Import read), Catalogue:OrganizationId (the local Identity organization whose members sign in) and Identity:Client (the local Identity at https://localhost:8404: Authority, ClientId, ClientSecret, CookieName).
